# Warlock AI Ollama

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-ollama`

> Ollama adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [Package orientation](@warlock.js/ai-ollama/skills/index.md): Provider adapter for local and self-hosted Ollama servers in Warlock AI applications. Exports `OllamaSDK` with model and provider configuration for the shared AI contracts. Use when connecting this provider, configuring host and headers, reasoning, embeddings and daemon errors, or diagnosing provider requests and usage. Read `setup-ollama` for construction and examples using an Ollama host. Not this package: agent loops, tools and workflows → @warlock.js/ai; HTTP and MCP tools → @warlock.js/ai-tools.
- [setup-ollama](@warlock.js/ai-ollama/setup-ollama/SKILL.md): Wire @warlock.js/ai-ollama — new OllamaSDK({host?, headers?}) for local / self-hosted Ollama via the official ollama client (not OpenAI-compat). chat + embed, daemon-down error handling. .model({name, vision?, reasoning?}) with cost-truth capabilities — reasoning inferred from thinking-model tags (deepseek-r1/qwq/qwen3/gpt-oss…), promptCaching/audio/pdf honestly false; options.reasoning → Ollama native `think` flag; usage reasoningTokens/cachedTokens stay undefined (none reported). Triggers: `providerOptions`, `OllamaCallOptions`, `countTokens`, `OllamaSDK`, `ollama.model`, `ollama.embedder`, `embedder.embedMany`, `ollama.count`, `host`, `headers`, `reasoning`, `think`, thinking models, `streamChunks`, `message.thinking`, `deepseek-r1`, `qwq`, `qwen3`, `gpt-oss`; "use ollama with warlock", "run llama3 locally", "self-hosted llama", "ollama reasoning / thinking models", "deepseek-r1 with warlock"; typical import `import { OllamaSDK } from "@warlock.js/ai-ollama"`. Skip: agent loop — the `run-ai-agent` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; provider choice — the `pick-ai-provider` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; embeddings core — the `embed-text` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill; siblings `@warlock.js/ai-openai`, `@warlock.js/ai-anthropic`, `@warlock.js/ai-google`; raw `ollama` npm, Vercel `@ai-sdk/ollama`; OpenAI-compat gateway via `@warlock.js/ai-openai` `baseURL`.
